newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto cut to neutral.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Friday she downgraded agricultural and life sciences firm Monsanto Co to neutral from buy.
-- In a report, Wittenburg said she expects Monsanto will buy the rest of DeKalb Genetics Corp. Monsanto now holds about 40 percent of DeKalb, an agricultural firm.
-- Purchasing the rest of DeKalb could cause dilution in the short-term, she added.
-- A Monsanto spokeswoman declined to comment on speculation that the company may buy the rest of DeKalb.

-- "It is our bet that the odds of Monsanto trying to get the rest of DeKalb are great enough that, when combined with the current price of Monsanto's shares, we'd prefer to be cautious here," Wittenburg said.
